newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen flat as focus on Maharani.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen flat as focus on Maharani.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen flat on Friday, with the market focus seen remaining on cement giant Indocement due to a proposed share sale and newly-listed finance firm Maharani, brokers said.
They said Maharani was likely to remain the market focus after it made a strong debut on Wednesday, closing about 50 percent higher from its initial offer price, brokers said.
Maharani, controlled by President Suharto's daughter Siti Hediati Prabowo (Titik Prabowo), is a multifinance firm with operations including consumer financing and leasing.
Blue chip Indocement was also likely to remain the market focus, but brokers said profit-taking was expected in the counter following recent strong gains.
Cement giant PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa said on Tuesday it proposed a spinoff and sale of its 50.1 percent shareholding in PT Indofood Sukses Makmur.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta Composite Index closed 1.29 points, or 0.18 percent higher, at 723.50 points. The market was closed on Thursday due to a public holiday.
